extraction_instruction: Extract expense commitments that include payer, amount, purpose, and due date. Exclude vague reminders, already-paid items, and plans without an amount.
Extract family care tasks that include a responsible person, recipient, concrete care action, and time. Exclude suggestions, completed actions, and tasks missing a time.
Extract travel commitments that include traveler, booking/payment action, item, and deadline. Exclude preferences, tentative ideas, and actions already completed.
Extract decisions that include the chosen option, decision maker/group, and effective date or release. Exclude open questions and action items without a final decision.
Extract unresolved blockers that include owner, blocked work, blocker, and next checkpoint. Exclude resolved blockers, FYI risks, and tasks without a checkpoint.
Extract forward-looking margin risks that include business line, metric, risk direction, condition, and time window. Exclude historical results and demand-neutral comments without a metric.
Extract suspicious bank transactions that include account, amount, merchant/counterparty, and reason. Exclude expected bills, reversed charges, and notes without an amount.
Extract math problem constraints that include variable, relation, value/expression, and context. Exclude narrative facts that do not constrain a variable.
Extract grading policy exceptions that include assessment, exception condition, and grading consequence. Exclude default grading rules and office-hour reminders.
Extract anomalous physics lab observations that include instrument/system, measured value, expected range/baseline, and suspected cause. Exclude normal readings and maintenance notes.
Extract failed calibration checks that include instrument, failed criterion, observed result, and required follow-up. Exclude passing checks and inventory notes.
Extract player availability restrictions that include player, team/context, restriction, and affected match/date. Exclude minor soreness without restriction and completed absences.

Extract decisive score-related events that include player/team, action, score impact, and match minute/period. Include scoring plays and prevented penalty shots that preserve a lead; exclude routine possessions and disallowed scores.
Extract discharge follow-ups that include patient, action, provider/location, and timing. Exclude general advice and completed inpatient steps.
Extract lab results needing urgent recheck that include marker, value, threshold/reason, patient, and deadline. Exclude normal values and routine annual labs.
Extract contract termination rights that include party, trigger condition, notice period, and consequence. Exclude renewal mechanics and payment reminders.
Extract audit remediation items that include control area, deficiency, owner, and due date. Exclude observations marked informational or already closed.
Extract delayed shipments requiring escalation that include order/customer, cause, new ETA, and escalation owner. Exclude on-time shipments and delays without owner.
Extract approved warehouse substitutions that include original item, substitute item, approver, and affected order/date. Exclude proposed substitutions and stock notes.
Extract hotel special requests that include guest, request, hotel response/status, and stay date. Exclude preferences not acknowledged by hotel.
Extract flight compensation eligibility cases with passenger, disruption, qualifying rule, and compensation offered/requested. Exclude weather-only delays and voluntary changes.
Extract manuscript revision tasks with author, manuscript section/figure, required change, and deadline. Exclude praise and optional future analyses.
Extract missing grant materials with owner, material, funder/program, and due date. Exclude materials already uploaded or merely recommended.
Extract reviewer comments requiring a mandatory response with reviewer, issue, manuscript area, and requested evidence/change. Exclude compliments and optional suggestions.
Extract breaking API changes with endpoint/field, old behavior, new behavior, and migration deadline/version. Exclude additive changes and documentation-only notes.

Extract urgent engineering triage items: P0/P1 bugs and breaking API migrations that require immediate developer action. Include the affected feature/API, severity or version/deadline, impact/change, owner or required migration. Exclude low-severity bugs, fixed items, documentation-only notes, and advisory deprecations without required action.
Extract eligible return cases with customer/item, eligibility reason, required condition, and deadline. Exclude final-sale items and expired windows.
Extract promotion exclusions with promotion, excluded item/category, reason/condition, and effective period. Exclude eligible examples and expired campaigns.
Extract passed civic motions with body, action, subject, vote count, and implementation date. Exclude tabled motions and discussion-only items.
Extract grant eligibility restrictions with program, applicant/category, restriction, and exception if any. Exclude application tips and scoring criteria.
Extract character promises that include speaker, promise, recipient/beneficiary, and time/place anchor. Exclude threats, memories, and vague wishes.
Extract revealed relationships with character A, character B, relationship, and evidence line. Exclude lies later contradicted in the scene.
Extract climate threshold projections with region/system, threshold, projected timing, and driver. Exclude historical observations and adaptation plans.
Extract biological experiment findings with organism/sample, treatment, measured outcome, and comparison/control. Exclude planned experiments and methods-only details.
Extract candidate astronomy anomalies with object/field, observed signal, expected baseline, and follow-up. Exclude known artifacts and routine detections.
Extract restaurant staffing changes with employee, shift/date, change type, and manager approval/status. Exclude requests not approved and normal assignments.
Extract menu allergen risks with dish, allergen, exposure source, and required warning/action. Exclude dishes already labeled correctly.

Extract binding property obligations, access limits, and repair constraints with party/location, obligation or constraint, amount/time limit, and trigger. Exclude background descriptions, optional amenities, and requests not stated as binding.
Extract mandatory property repairs with location, defect, responsible party, and deadline/urgency. Exclude cosmetic notes and already completed repairs.
Extract privacy sharing restrictions with data type, recipient, restriction, and exception/condition. Exclude general transparency statements.
Extract access removals that include user/group, system, reason, and deadline. Exclude access confirmations and pending investigations without removal.
Extract timeline events with actor, action, location/topic, and date/time. Exclude analysis or background context.
Extract covered insurance claims with claimant, loss, policy basis, and payout/next step. Exclude excluded losses and incomplete claims.
Extract utility outage incidents requiring customer notification with area, utility/system, cause, and notification timing. Exclude internal drills and resolved notices already sent.
Extract museum loan conditions with artwork/object, lender, condition, and deadline/display period. Exclude curatorial notes and completed shipments.
Extract students at risk with student, course component, risk trigger, and required intervention. Exclude students on track and generic advice.
Extract production defects requiring hold with line/product, defect, affected batch, and disposition. Exclude cosmetic defects below threshold and already released lots.
Extract gameplay changes that nerf or buff a named item/character with target, change direction, numeric value, and patch version. Exclude bug fixes and cosmetic changes.
Extract property showing constraints with property, visitor/agent, constraint, and time window. Exclude marketing descriptions and canceled showings.
Extract sponsor obligations with sponsor, deliverable, placement/timing, and penalty/condition. Exclude informal ideas and already completed reads.
